Wipro Consumer Care Buys Dermatouch, L'Oreal Acquires Onesto Labs

Wipro Consumer Care has acquired Dermatouch, marking its 18th acquisition and entry into India's premium skincare segment. This move also strengthens Wipro's global beauty and personal care portfolio. Separately, the Competition Commission of India (CCI) has approved L'Oreal India's acquisition of the personal care firm Onesto Labs.
